This only affects forkchoice right? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5206 but the spec behavior is wrong imo Yeah I think this issue is irrelevant really, whatever you add is not enforceable unless you make it a consensus change (like adding the index in the message) and then I'd be really against these changes I don't think you need that, there is no reason why a validator should cast 2 different votes, but their weight should be counted properly if votes are in the same slot see https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5222 The forkchoice situation is really irrelevant, the only problem could be P2P downscoring but that shouldn't happen Yeah I saw that and it's fine if you want to add that logic to find these cases in clients. Then Prysm will get the wrong head And then I'd dislike these tests That's good to know! Yeah I think testing reorgs here is way out of scope I'll review If you're just adding an extra check that we can ignore then I don't mind I suggest we remove the tests from my PR and let your PR handle it?
